body:
#### PR description:

- Previously the proxy returned by a `const edm:New::DetSetVector` could be used to modify the stored information. Now their are distinct mutable and immutable proxies and iterators.
- also switched from typedef to using
- extended unit tests 

(Code modifications primarily done via AI)

#### PR validation:

Framework code compiles and related unit tests pass.

resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/1106
title: Fix const correctness issue in edmNew::DetSetVector
